venues.name: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca
venues.notes: Historic races / Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion

events.title: Pebble Beach Motoring Classic
events.summary: Concours-bound classics arrive after a multi-day tour — a low-key way to see entrants before Sunday.
events.description: Watch cars and crews as they complete the Motoring Classic. Great photo ops and a preview of Concours machinery. Confirm route and public viewing spots on the official calendar.

events.title: Monterey Car Week begins
events.summary: Official and satellite events ramp up across Monterey County.
events.description: Use this day to settle in, pick up credentials if needed, and map free roadside viewing for Tour day and auction previews. Many satellite meets begin this weekend.

events.title: Collector car auctions (week)
events.summary: Major auction houses host viewing and sales across mid-week — check each house for exact times.
events.description: Preview lots during public viewing windows, then attend evening sales if ticketed. Bring ID and register early if you plan to bid. Times and venues vary by auctioneer — always confirm on their sites.

events.title: Pebble Beach Tour d’Elegance
events.summary: Concours entrants drive a public scenic route — the best free chance to see them in motion.
events.description: Concours-bound cars prove their roadworthiness on Highway 1 and local roads. Watch roadside in Carmel, Pacific Grove, and along the coast. Arrive early for parking; stay back from corners; do not block driveways.

events.title: Concours Village
events.summary: Exhibits, shopping, and automotive displays near the Concours grounds.
events.description: Free-to-enter village atmosphere with brands, merchandise, and displays. Pair with Tour day for a full Thursday. Confirm hours each year on the official calendar.

events.title: Pebble Beach Classic Car Forum
events.summary: Talks and panels with collectors, historians, and industry voices.
events.description: Indoor sessions on design, restoration, and collecting. Ideal if you want depth beyond the show field. Tickets and schedule via official channels.

events.title: Pebble Beach RetroAuto
events.summary: Automobilia, literature, art, and collectibles market.
events.description: Shop models, posters, books, and memorabilia. Great companion to the Forum and Village. Confirm access rules on the official site.

events.title: The Quail, A Motorsports Gathering
events.summary: Garden-party concours with motorsport icons and haute cuisine — tickets are scarce.
events.description: One of the week’s most sought-after paid events. Expect curated classes, manufacturer displays, and a relaxed lawn atmosphere. Plan transport early; parking fills.

events.title: Concours d’Lemons
events.summary: Anti-concours celebration of the odd, ugly, and earnest — free and fun.
events.description: The humorous counterpoint to Concours Sunday. Expect Yugos, barn finds, and categories that reward character over polish. Location can shift — verify Seaside details for 2026.

events.title: Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance
events.summary: The 75th Concours on the 18th fairway — Best of Show culminates Car Week.
events.description: Flagship event of Pebble Beach Automotive Week. Dawn access for credentialed spectators; classes judged through the day; awards in the afternoon. Tickets via official Concours store. Arrive early for security and parking.

events.title: Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion (typical)
events.summary: Historic racing at Laguna Seca — multi-day; confirm 2026 schedule.
events.description: Period race cars on a legendary track. Often runs multiple days mid-to-late week. Buy tickets in advance and plan for traffic on Highway 68.
